xln.text: Tishana meditated in the Primal Wellspring with Kopala when the pulse of Orazca skipped a beat, and she told Kopala that whatever involved Orazca involved the whole world.
When Kumena argued that the River Heralds must wield the Immortal Sun themselves, Tishana insisted it be kept hidden and unused as the Last Guardian had asked, and Kopala sided with her.
She pursued Kumena to the coast and overpowered his spell against the approaching ships, but he punched her and knocked her out.

Huatli found her unconscious on a rock, and Tishana, warning that Kumena had betrayed her cause, agreed to guide her to Orazca in an alliance, though she would kill her if she tried to claim the city.
